# Automation app – guide for AI assistants

<!-- Generated by app/src/test/java/cz/natsu/automation/AiGuideExport.kt – do not edit by hand. -->

**Automation** is an Android app (package `cz.natsu.automation`) where users build automations from blocks
(steps): text tools, clipboard, sharing, HTTP/JSON APIs, dialogs, notifications, files, device settings,
conditions and loops. An automation is started by hand (selected text, Share sheet, quick-settings tile,
copying to the clipboard) or by a system event (Wi-Fi, charger, time, NFC tag, notification, …).

When a user asks you for an automation, **write it as a script** in the format described below. It is the
same text the app shows under *automation settings → Show as script*, plus a few `# @` header lines for
how the automation starts. Answer the user in their language (the app is in English and Czech).

## 1. What to give the user

1. **The script** in one code block (start it with the `# @name` header). Use only the blocks, parameters,
   values and events listed in this guide.
2. **How to get it into the phone** – copy these steps for the user:
   1. Open the web editor https://natsu13.github.io/Automation/
   2. Click **Import**, paste the script into the text box and click **Import**. The steps appear as blocks;
      check them (the *Code* tab shows the script again).
   3. **Export → This automation** downloads a `.automation.json` file. Send it to the phone (e-mail,
      cloud, cable…).
   4. In the app: **⋮ → Import from file** (or share / open the `.json` file with the Automation app).
   5. An imported automation does not run until the user opens it, checks the steps and taps the banner
      to allow it.
   - Without the web editor: create a new automation in the app, add the block **Script** and paste the
     script lines into it (the `# @` lines are comments there; set the start in the automation's settings).
3. **What to allow on the phone** – list the permissions of the blocks and events you used (see
   *Requires* in the reference, e.g. notifications, location, “Do not disturb” access). The app asks for
   them in the editor, but saying it up front helps.
4. **How to start it** – e.g. “select text → menu → *your automation name*”, “Share → Automation”,
   the quick-settings tile, or that it runs by itself on the chosen event.
5. If something needs a secret (API key, token): tell the user to add it in the app under
   **Settings → Secret values** with the name you used in `secret("name")`. Secrets never leave the phone.

## 2. Quick example

A user asks: *“When I share a link, remove the tracking parameters and copy it.”*

```
# @name "Clean link"
# @icon link
# @triggers share, process_text
url = extract({source: input, what: "url", which: "first"})
if url != ""
    clean = block("replace", url, "(?<=[?&])(utm_[a-z_]+|fbclid|gclid|si|igsh|ref|ref_src)=[^&#]*&?", "", true)
    clean2 = block("replace", clean, "[?&]+(?=#|$)", "", true)
    set_clipboard(clean2)
    toast("Copied: " & clean2)
else
    toast("No link in: " & input)
end
```

- `url = extract(…)` runs the block **Find in text** and names its output `url`; later steps use it by that name.
- `block("replace", …)` – **Replace text** is named like a script function, so it is called through `block("type", …)`.
- `input` is the text the automation was started with (the shared or selected text).
- Parameters go in the block's order (`source, what, which`), or by name in `{ }` to skip some.

## 3. The script format

### Header (how the automation starts)

Comment lines at the top. Only `# @name` is needed; leave out what does not apply.

```
# @name "Morning summary"
# @icon schedule
# @triggers share, process_text, tile, clipboard
# @event time_daily(time: "07:30", days: "12345")
# @conditions all
# @condition launch_condition({source: "wifi_name", op: "equals", right: "Home"})
```

- `@triggers` – manual starts: `process_text` (select text → menu), `share` (Share sheet), `tile`
  (quick-settings tile), `clipboard` (when the user copies text).
- `@event type(param: "value", …)` – one line per event; all values are text in quotes. See *Events*.
- `@condition` – launch conditions checked before the first step (block *Launch condition*, see below);
  `@conditions all` = all must hold, `any` = one is enough.
- `@icon` – one of: `bolt`, `paste`, `text`, `translate`, `link`, `volume`, `phone`, `star`, `code`, `magic`, `home`, `work`, `school`, `favorite`, `alarm`, `schedule`, `timer`, `hourglass`, `calendar`, `event`, `notifications`, `mail`, `chat`, `call`, `send`, `share`, `camera`, `image`, `video`, `music`, `headphones`, `mic`, `play`, `pause`, `repeat`, `shuffle`, `sync`, `refresh`, `wifi`, `bluetooth`, `nfc`, `airplane`, `battery`, `power`, `flashlight`, `vibration`, `dnd`, `rotation`, `light`, `dark`, `sleep`, `location`, `map`, `car`, `bike`, `train`, `flight`, `shopping`, `money`, `card`, `savings`, `food`, `coffee`, `fitness`, `health`, `pets`, `cloud`, `water`, `fire`, `eco`, `lock`, `unlock`, `key`, `security`, `visibility`, `search`, `settings`, `tune`, `build`, `bug`, `terminal`, `api`, `http`, `data`, `storage`, `public`, `rss`, `download`, `upload`, `save`, `folder`, `file`, `note`, `edit`, `copy`, `cut`, `delete`, `checklist`, `check`, `info`, `warning`, `question`, `lightbulb`, `rocket`, `game`, `tv`, `computer`, `watch`, `print`, `qr`, `numbers`, `calculate`, `person`, `group`, `face`, `thumb`, `flag`, `bookmark`, `tag`, `pin`, `palette`, `brush`, `crop`, `filter`.

### Steps

One step per line, indented by 4 spaces inside `if` / `for` / `while` / groups.

| Write | Block |
|---|---|
| `name = block_type(arg1, arg2)` | a block; `name` holds its output for later steps (only blocks with an output) |
| `block_type({param: value, other: value})` | the same with parameters by name (to skip some) |
| `name = block("replace", …)` | blocks named like a function: `replace`, `text`, `random`, `date` |
| `name = value` | **Set variable** (a variable) |
| `name = "text " & input` | for an existing **Text** step; in new scripts it makes a variable |
| `name = a + b` / `name = calc("2 * (x + 1)")` | **Calculate** (simple / expression) |
| `if cond` … `else if cond` … `else` … `end` | **If**, **Otherwise if**, **Otherwise** |
| `while cond` … `end` | **Repeat while** |
| `for item in list` … `end` | **For each item** – `item` is the current item |
| `for i in range(5)` … `end` | **Repeat several times** – `i` is the round number |
| `break` / `continue` | **End loop / skip round** |
| `return value` | **Return result** – ends the run with a result |
| `# text` | **Note** (a note); a commented-out block call is a switched-off step |
| anything else in the script language | **Script** – a few lines of code (see *Script language*) |

### Values (block parameters)

- Text: `"Hello\n"` (`\n` new line, `\"` quote, `\\` backslash), numbers bare: `5`, `2.5`.
- Join with `&`: `"Battery " & event("battery") & " %"`.
- Built-in values: `input` (the started-with text), `trigger` (how it was started), `clipboard`, `date()`
  (current date and time).
- Step outputs and variables by name: `url`, `total`; a variable with spaces: `var("my value")`.
- `secret("api_key")` – a secret stored on the phone.
- `event("wifi_name")` – a value of the event that started the run (see *Event values*; the block
  **Event data** does the same).
- Choice parameters take one of the listed values in quotes: `"url"`. Switches: `true` / `false`.
- A text parameter takes only texts, numbers, names and `&`. To compute (upper case, length, maths, JSON),
  use a block for it, or a line of script code: `n = len(input)` becomes a Script step.
- `trigger` is the start type in the app's language: "Manual" / "Ručně", "Sharing" / "Sdílení", "Text selection" / "Výběr textu", "Clipboard" / "Schránka", "Tile" / "Dlaždice", "Notification button" / "Tlačítko oznámení", "Event" / "Událost"
  (for an event: the event's title). Prefer `contains(trigger, "Share") or contains(trigger, "Sdílení")`.

### Conditions (`if`, `else if`, `while`)

| Write | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `a == b`, `a != b` | equal / not equal (letters' case is ignored) |
| `a == ""`, `a != ""` | empty / not empty |
| `a > b`, `a < b`, `a >= b`, `a <= b` | numbers |
| `contains(a, b)`, `not contains(a, b)` | text contains |
| `starts(a, b)`, `ends(a, b)` | starts / ends with |
| `matches(a, "regex")` | regular expression |
| anything else, e.g. `x > 5 and contains(input, "a")` | an expression (and / or / not, functions) |

### Groups that exist only as blocks

Try, parallel branches, one-at-a-time and time limits have no script keyword. Write their marker lines exactly (the title, two spaces, the note in parentheses) and indent the steps inside by 4 spaces. Their settings (retries, time limit, lock name) keep their defaults; the user can change them in the editor.

```
# Try  (only as blocks, not in a script)
    response = http_request({url: "https://api.example.com/items", only_body: true})
# On failure  (only as blocks, not in a script)
    toast("API not available")
# End of Try  (only as blocks, not in a script)

# In parallel  (only as blocks, not in a script)
    a = http_request({url: "https://api.example.com/a", only_body: true})
# Meanwhile  (only as blocks, not in a script)
    b = http_request({url: "https://api.example.com/b", only_body: true})
# End of parallel branches  (only as blocks, not in a script)
```

Also: `# One at a time  (only as blocks, not in a script)` … `# End of One at a time  (only as blocks, not in a script)`, `# Time limit  (only as blocks, not in a script)` … `# End of time limit  (only as blocks, not in a script)`.

### Choose by (switch)

```
# Choose by input
if input == "morning" or input == "am"
    toast("Good morning")
else if input == "evening"
    toast("Good evening")
else
    toast("Hello")
end
```

The `if` / `else if` / `else` / `end` of a switch are indented exactly like its `# Choose by` line.

### Script language

Lines that are not a block become a **Script** step. Its language:

```text
A short program. The result of the block is the value after return, or
the result of the last line. Variables are shared with the Set variable
block: what the script sets, later steps see, and the other way round.
Insert values of other steps with the { } button; the automation's
input is input.

Values
• numbers 12 and 1.5 (decimal point), texts "hello" or 'hello'
• true / false, null (an empty value)
• a list [1, 2, 3], an object {name: "Jan", age: 30}
• a text with JSON (an API response, say) acts as a list / object

Operations
• + - * / % (remainder) ^ (power), parentheses
• & joins texts: "Hello " & name
• == != < <= > >=
• and, or, not (also &&, ||, !)

Statements (English or Czech)
• x = 5, x += 1, list[0] = "a", person.age = 31
• if condition … else if … else … end
• while condition … end
• for item in list … end
• break (ends the loop), continue (next round)
• return value
• # a note to the end of the line

Reading data
• list[0] the first, list[-1] the last
• response.body.items[0].title

Built-in variables
• input, clipboard, trigger
• event("wifi_name"), secret("name")

Functions – text
• len(x), upper(x), lower(x), trim(x)
• replace(text, what, with), contains(text, what)
• ==, contains, starts and ends ignore upper / lower case
  (like the If block); exact(a, b) compares exactly
• starts(text, start), ends(text, end)
• split(text, separator), join(list, separator)
• substr(text, from, length), find(text, what)
• match(text, regex), matches(text, regex)

Functions – numbers
• round(x, places), floor(x), ceil(x), abs(x), sqrt(x)
• min(…), max(…), sum(list), avg(list)
• num(text), int(x), random(from, to)
• calc("1 000 * 1,21") – the calculator of the Calculate block

Functions – lists and others
• range(5) → 1 to 5, range(2, 4)
• push(list, x), keys(object), values(object)
• json(text), tojson(value), type(x)
• iif(condition, a, b), date("d. M. yyyy"), now()
• var("name with a space") – a variable that cannot be written by name

Blocks as functions
Every block can be called by its type. Write parameters by name in { },
or one after another in the order they have in the block.
• res = http_request({url: "https://api.example.com/items"})
• toast("Done: " & len(res.body.items))
• set_clipboard(result), vibrate(300)
• ask_text({title: "Name?"}), open_app("Spotify")
• block("replace", {source: t, find: "a", replacement: "b"}) – for
  blocks named like a function (replace, text, random)
The automation's settings → Show as script writes your steps this
way, so you can see every block's type and parameters.

Example
total = 0
for p in response.body.items
    if p.price > 100
        total += p.price
    end
end
return "Total " & round(total, 2)
```

### Checklist before answering

- Every block type, parameter name and choice value comes from the reference below – do not invent any.
- Steps whose output is used later are named (`name = …`); names are letters, digits and `_`, not a
  script word (`if`, `end`, `input`, `text`, `date`, `list`, `count`, `type`, …).
- Every `if`, `while`, `for` and `# Choose by` has its `end`; marker groups have their end line.
- Blocks named like a function go through `block("…", …)`.
- Dialogs, the clipboard and opening apps need the screen; in background events the app opens a window,
  which needs *Display over other apps*.
- Events only from the list; their parameters are text in quotes.

## 4. Events

`# @event key(param: "value")`. `input` = what the started run gets as its input.

| Key | Event | Parameters (default) | `input` | Needs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `wifi_connected` | Wi-Fi connected – When the phone connects to Wi-Fi. Input = network name (needs location access). | – | Wi-Fi name | location access (for the Wi-Fi name) |
| `wifi_disconnected` | Wi-Fi disconnected – When the phone stops using Wi-Fi. Input = the network it left. | – | Wi-Fi name | location access (for the Wi-Fi name) |
| `mobile_connected` | Switch to mobile data – When the internet starts going over mobile data. | – | – | – |
| `offline` | Internet lost – When the phone has no internet connection. | – | – | – |
| `airplane_on` | Airplane mode on – When airplane mode is turned on. | – | – | – |
| `airplane_off` | Airplane mode off – When airplane mode is turned off. | – | – | – |
| `power_connected` | Charger connected – When the phone starts charging. | – | baterie v % | – |
| `power_disconnected` | Charger disconnected – When the charger is unplugged. | – | baterie v % | – |
| `battery_below` | Battery drops below – Once, when the charge drops below the chosen level. | `percent` ("20") | baterie v % | – |
| `battery_above` | Battery charged above – Once, when the charge passes the chosen level while charging (80 % for gentle charging, say). | `percent` ("80") | baterie v % | – |
| `screen_on` | Screen on – When the screen turns on (on the lock screen too). | – | – | – |
| `screen_off` | Screen off – When the screen turns off. | – | – | – |
| `unlocked` | Phone unlocked – When you unlock the phone. | – | – | – |
| `bt_connected` | Bluetooth device connected – When headphones, a car, a watch… connects. Input = device name. | – | device name | Nearby devices (Bluetooth) permission |
| `bt_disconnected` | Bluetooth device disconnected – When a Bluetooth device disconnects. | – | device name | Nearby devices (Bluetooth) permission |
| `headset_plugged` | Headphones plugged in – Wired headphones (jack or USB-C). | – | – | – |
| `headset_unplugged` | Headphones unplugged – Wired headphones (jack or USB-C). | – | – | – |
| `dnd_changed` | Do Not Disturb changed – When Do Not Disturb turns on or off. Input = zapnuto / vypnuto. | – | zapnuto / vypnuto | – |
| `nfc_tag` | NFC tag scanned – When you hold an NFC tag to the phone (the display has to be on). Input = the text on the tag, or its ID when it is empty. | – | tag text or ID | NFC switched on |
| `sms_received` | Incoming SMS – When a text message arrives. Input = the text; the Event values block returns the sender. | – | message text | SMS permission |
| `incoming_call` | Incoming call – When the phone starts ringing. Input = the caller's number (empty for a hidden number). | – | caller's number | phone and call log permission |
| `place_entered` | Arriving at a place – When the phone gets within the circle around the chosen place. Android usually notices within a few minutes. | `place` "lat, lng" or an address, `radius` metres ("200") | – | location access "Allow all the time" |
| `place_left` | Leaving a place – When the phone leaves the circle around the chosen place. | `place` "lat, lng" or an address, `radius` metres ("200") | – | location access "Allow all the time" |
| `sunrise` | Sunrise – Every day at sunrise at the chosen place. A shift (say half an hour later) is done with the Wait block. | `place` "lat, lng" or an address | – | – |
| `sunset` | Sunset – Every day at sunset at the chosen place. | `place` "lat, lng" or an address | – | – |
| `time_daily` | At a set time – Every chosen day at the given time. | `time` "HH:MM" ("07:00"), `days` digits 1=Mon…7=Sun ("1234567") | – | – |
| `time_interval` | Repeatedly – Every N minutes (at least 15). In battery saver Android may shift the run by a few minutes. | `minutes` ("60", at least 15) | – | – |
| `notification` | Incoming notification – When any app shows a notification. Input = text; the app and title come from the Event data block, filter them in Launch conditions. | – | notification text | notification access (system settings) |
| `app_opened` | App opened – When another app comes to the screen. Input = its package (e.g. com.spotify.music); choose the app you want in Launch conditions. | – | app package | the app's accessibility service switched on |
| `boot` | After the phone starts – Once after the phone boots. | – | – | – |

### Event values

`event("key")` in a step, or the block **Event data**:

- `wifi_name` – Wi-Fi name: The name of the connected Wi-Fi network (needs location access).
- `network` – Connection type: wifi / mobile / none
- `battery` – Battery (%): The current battery charge in percent.
- `charging` – Charging: true / false
- `bt_device` – Bluetooth device: The device name from a Bluetooth event.
- `dnd` – Do Not Disturb: zapnuto / vypnuto
- `notif_app` – Notification – app: The name of the app that sent the notification.
- `notif_package` – Notification – package: The app's package, e.g. com.whatsapp.
- `notif_title` – Notification – title: The notification title (often the sender).
- `notif_text` – Notification – text: The notification text.
- `nfc_id` – NFC tag – ID: The number of the tag, e.g. 04:A2:1B:…; an empty tag has one too.
- `nfc_text` – NFC tag – text: The text or link stored on the tag.
- `sms_sender` – SMS – sender: The number or name of the sender of the message.
- `sms_text` – SMS – text: The text of the message.
- `call_number` – Call – number: The caller's number (needs access to the call log).
- `app_package` – App – package: The package of the opened app, e.g. com.spotify.music.
- `app_name` – App – name: The name of the opened app.

### Launch conditions

`# @condition launch_condition({…})` with these parameters:

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | choice | `"simple"` | Notation · `"simple"` Simple – a value and a condition, `"expert"` Expression – and / or, numbers, functions |
| `source` | choice | `"custom"` | What to check · `"custom"` Custom value (text and variables), `"input"` Input, `"trigger"` Trigger type, `"wifi_name"` Wi-Fi name, `"network"` Connection type, `"battery"` Battery (%), `"charging"` Charging, `"bt_device"` Bluetooth device, `"dnd"` Do Not Disturb mode, `"notif_app"` Notification – app, `"notif_title"` Notification – title, `"notif_text"` Notification – text, `"notif_package"` Notification – app package, `"sms_sender"` SMS – sender, `"sms_text"` SMS – text, `"call_number"` Call – number, `"nfc_id"` NFC tag – ID, `"nfc_text"` NFC tag – text, `"app_package"` App – package, `"app_name"` App – name · *only when `mode` is "simple"* |
| `left` | text | `input` | Value · *only when `mode` is "simple" and `source` is "custom"* |
| `op` | choice | `"equals"` | Condition · `"equals"` is equal to, `"not_equals"` is not equal to, `"contains"` contains, `"not_contains"` does not contain, `"starts"` starts with, `"ends"` ends with, `"matches"` matches the regular expression, `"empty"` is empty, `"not_empty"` is not empty, `"greater"` is greater than, `"less"` is less than, `"greater_eq"` is greater than or equal to, `"less_eq"` is less than or equal to · *only when `mode` is "simple"* |
| `right` | text | `""` | Compare with · e.g. hodnota · *only when `mode` is "simple" and `op` is "equals" / "not_equals" / "contains" / "not_contains" / "starts" / "ends" / "matches" / "greater" / "less" / "greater_eq" / "less_eq"* |
| `expression` | text | `""` | Expression · e.g. battery < 20 or state == "vip" · *only when `mode` is "expert"* |


## 5. Blocks

Signature = the parameters in order for positional calls. Defaults are used for parameters you leave out. *Output* is the kind of value the step gives (name it in the script). Titles are English / Czech, as the app shows them.

### Text

#### `text` – Text / Text

A text you can insert variables into. The result can be used in later steps.

- Signature: `block("text", text)`
- Output: Text (e.g. `text_result = …`)

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | text | `""` | Text · e.g. Write a text… |

#### `replace` – Replace text / Nahradit text

Replaces occurrences of the searched text. Optionally as a regular expression ($1 = group).

- Signature: `block("replace", source, find, replacement, regex, ignoreCase)`
- Output: Edited text (e.g. `edited_text = …`)

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | text | `input` | In text |
| `find` | text | `""` | Find · e.g. co hledat |
| `replacement` | text | `""` | Replace with · e.g. nic = smazat |
| `regex` | true/false | `false` | Regular expression |
| `ignoreCase` | true/false | `true` | Ignore case |

#### `change_case` – Change case / Změnit velikost písmen

Converts the text to upper case, lower case or capitalized.

- Signature: `change_case(source, mode)`
- Output: Text (e.g. `text_result = …`)

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | text | `input` | Text |
| `mode` | choice | `"upper"` | To · `"upper"` UPPER CASE, `"lower"` lower case, `"words"` Every Word Capitalized, `"sentence"` First letter capitalized |

#### `clean_text` – Clean text / Vyčistit text

Removes spaces at the start and end, doubled spaces or line breaks.

- Signature: `clean_text(source, mode)`
- Output: Text (e.g. `text_result = …`)

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | text | `input` | Text |
| `mode` | choice | `"trim"` | What to do · `"trim"` Trim spaces at the edges, `"spaces"` Merge repeated spaces, `"lines"` Join lines into one, `"all"` All of the above |

#### `count` – Count / Spočítat

Counts characters, words or lines in a text.

- Signature: `count(source, what)`
- Output: Count (e.g. `count_result = …`)

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | text | `input` | Text |
| `what` | choice | `"chars"` | What · `"chars"` Characters, `"words"` Words, `"lines"` Lines |

#### `extract` – Find in text / Najít v textu

Extracts links, e-mails, phone numbers, numbers or a regular expression match from a text.

- Signature: `extract(source, what, pattern, which)`
- Output: Found (e.g. `found = …`)

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | text | `input` | In text |
| `what` | choice | `"url"` | What to find · `"url"` Links, `"email"` E-mails, `"phone"` Phone numbers, `"number"` Numbers, `"regex"` Regular expression |
| `pattern` | text (plain) | `""` | Regular expression · e.g. #\w+ · *only when `what` is "regex"* |
| `which` | choice | `"first"` | Which · `"first"` The first one found, `"all"` All (one per line), `"count"` Only the count |

#### `convert` – Convert text / Převést text

Removes diacritics, encodes / decodes URL or Base64, reverses a text.

- Signature: `convert(source, mode)`
- Output: Converted text (e.g. `converted_text = …`)

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | text | `input` | Text |
| `mode` | choice | `"diacritics"` | Conversion · `"diacritics"` Remove diacritics (č → c), `"url_encode"` URL encode, `"url_decode"` URL decode, `"b64_encode"` Base64 encode, `"b64_decode"` Base64 decode, `"reverse"` Reverse the characters |

### Numbers

#### `math` – Calculate / Vypočítat

Computes a result from two numbers, or in Expert mode a whole expression: parentheses, powers, rounding, min / max… (help under ?).

- Signature: `math(mode, a, op, b, expression)`
- Output: Result (e.g. `result = …`)

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | choice | `"simple"` | Notation · `"simple"` Simple – two numbers, `"expert"` Expert – an expression as text |
| `a` | text | `0` | Number · *only when `mode` is "simple"* |
| `op` | choice | `"+"` | Operation · `"+"` + add, `"-"` − subtract, `"*"` × multiply, `"/"` ÷ divide, `"%"` remainder · *only when `mode` is "simple"* |
| `b` | text | `0` | Number · *only when `mode` is "simple"* |
| `expression` | text | `""` | Expression · e.g. round(price * 1.21; 2) · *only when `mode` is "expert"* |

<details><summary>Help</summary>

```text
Simple notation: two numbers and an operation (+ − × ÷, remainder).

Expert – an expression written as text. Numbers can come from variables.

Operations
• + − addition, subtraction
• * or × multiplication, / or : division
• % remainder (10 % 3 = 1)
• ^ power (2 ^ 10 = 1024)
• parentheses ( ) set the order

Functions (separate arguments with a semicolon ;)
• round(x) and round(x; places) – rounding
• floor(x) down, ceil(x) up
• abs(x) absolute value, sqrt(x) square root
• min(a; b; …), max(a; b; …)

Numbers
• decimal comma or point: 1,5 = 1.5
• spaces between thousands are ignored: 1 000 000

Examples
• price * 1,21 → price with VAT
• round(sum / count; 2) → average to 2 places
• max(0; balance - payment)
• (temperature * 9 / 5) + 32 → °C to °F
```

</details>

#### `random` – Random number / Náhodné číslo

Returns a random whole number in the given range (both ends included).

- Signature: `block("random", min, max)`
- Output: Random number (e.g. `random_number = …`)

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `min` | text | `1` | From |
| `max` | text | `100` | To |

### Sharing and web

#### `share` – Share / Sdílet

Opens the system Share sheet with a text – you pick the app to send it to.

- Signature: `share(text, title)`
- Shows something on screen

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | text | `input` | Text to share |
| `title` | text (plain) | `""` | Sheet title · e.g. optional |

#### `web` – Load web page / Načíst webovou stránku

Downloads a page from the internet. It can also expand a shortened link (bit.ly, t.co…) to its target address.

- Signature: `web(url, what)`
- Output: Web (e.g. `web_result = …`)
- Shows something on screen

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | text | `input` | Address |
| `what` | choice | `"final_url"` | What to return · `"final_url"` Target address (after redirects), `"title"` Page title, `"text"` Page text (without HTML), `"raw"` Source code |

#### `share_file` – Share file / Sdílet soubor

Opens the Share sheet with a file or an image – an edited or downloaded one, say.

- Signature: `share_file(file, text)`
- Shows something on screen

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | text | `""` | File · e.g. výstup bloku Vybrat soubor, Upravit obrázek, stažený soubor nebo https:// adresa |
| `text` | text | `""` | Text to share · e.g. optional |

#### `save_file` – Save file / Uložit soubor

Saves a file to the Gallery (images, the Automation folder) or to Downloads. Returns its address.

- Signature: `save_file(file, where, name)`
- Output: Saved file (e.g. `saved_file = …`)

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | text | `""` | File · e.g. výstup bloku Vybrat soubor, Upravit obrázek, stažený soubor nebo https:// adresa |
| `where` | choice | `"auto"` | Where · `"auto"` Images to the Gallery, the rest to Downloads, `"gallery"` Gallery (Pictures), `"downloads"` Downloads |
| `name` | text | `""` | File name · e.g. keep the original |

#### `write_file` – Write to file / Zapsat do souboru

Writes a text into a file: adds it as a new line, adds it to the end, or replaces the file with it. The file comes from the block File to write to.

- Signature: `write_file(file, content, mode)`

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | text | `""` | File · e.g. output of the block File to write to |
| `content` | text | `""` | Text |
| `mode` | choice | `"line"` | How · `"line"` Add as a new line, `"append"` Add to the end, `"overwrite"` Replace the whole file |

#### `add_record` – Add record to file / Přidat záznam do souboru

Adds one record made of name=value pairs (one per line) to a file. A CSV gets a new row, and an empty file gets a header made of the names first; a .json file gets an object at the end of its list. The format is told from the file's extension unless you set it (csv or json – a variable works too).

- Signature: `add_record(file, values, format, separator)`

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | text | `""` | File · e.g. output of the block File to write to |
| `values` | text | `""` | Values · e.g. time=… ⏎ text=… |
| `format` | text | `""` | Format · e.g. by the file's extension · common: `csv`, `json` |
| `separator` | choice | `";"` | CSV separator · `";"` Semicolon ; (Czech Excel), `","` Comma ,, `"	"` Tab |

#### `file_info` – File detail / Údaj o souboru

Returns one thing about a file: its extension (csv, json, txt… – handy for the Format field or a condition), its name, or its size in bytes.

- Signature: `file_info(file, what)`
- Output: File detail (e.g. `file_detail = …`)

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | text | `""` | File · e.g. output of the block File to write to |
| `what` | choice | `"extension"` | What · `"extension"` Extension (format), `"name"` Name, `"size"` Size in bytes |

#### `read_file` – Read file / Přečíst soubor

Returns the content of a file: as text (notes, CSV, JSON), or encoded as Base64 for APIs that want the file in the request body.

- Signature: `read_file(file, format)`
- Output: File content (e.g. `file_content = …`)

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | text | `""` | File · e.g. output of Pick file, file://… or https://… |
| `format` | choice | `"text"` | As · `"text"` Text, `"base64"` Base64 |

### API, JSON and lists

#### `json_get` – Get from JSON / Získat z JSON

Extracts a value from JSON by a path, e.g. data.items[0].url or items[*].url (all of them). Objects and arrays are returned as JSON, so they can be processed further or looped over.

- Signature: `json_get(source, path, what, fallback)`
- Output: Value from JSON (e.g. `value_from_json = …`)

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | text | `input` | JSON |
| `path` | text | `""` | Path · e.g. data.items[*].url (empty = the whole JSON) |
| `what` | choice | `"value"` | What to return · `"value"` Value, `"count"` Number of items, `"keys"` Key names (a list), `"exists"` Whether it exists (true / false), `"pretty"` Nicely formatted JSON |
| `fallback` | text | `""` | When missing, return · e.g. empty text · *only when `what` is "value" / "pretty"* |

<details><summary>Help</summary>

```text
The path says where in the JSON the value is.

• name → the value of the key name
• user.address.city → nested objects
• items[0] → the first item of an array, items[-1] the last
• items[*].url → url of all items (returns a list)
• ["key with a space"] → a key with special characters
• empty path → the whole JSON

Objects and arrays are returned as JSON, so they can go to another
Get from JSON, For each item or List operations block.

In the response of an HTTP request the body is under body:
body.items[0].title, the status code is status.
```

</details>

#### `json_build` – Create JSON / Vytvořit JSON

Builds JSON from "key: value" lines (a dot in the key makes a nested object: user.name), or an array from lines. Handy as the body of a POST request.

- Signature: `json_build(kind, items, typed)`
- Output: JSON (e.g. `json = …`)

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | choice | `"object"` | Create · `"object"` Object from key: value lines, `"array"` Array – every line is one item |
| `items` | text | `""` | Items · e.g. title: Ahoj ⏎ user.id: 42 |
| `typed` | true/false | `true` | Numbers and true / false as values (not text) |

<details><summary>Help</summary>

```text
Every line is key: value.

• title: Hello → {"title": "Hello"}
• user.id: 42 → a nested object {"user": {"id": 42}}
• tags: ["a", "b"] → an array
• done: true → true / false

With the switch “Numbers and true / false as values” 42 is stored as
a number, without it as the text "42".

Array from lines: every line is one item.
```

</details>

#### `json_set` – Edit JSON / Upravit JSON

Sets, appends to an array or deletes the value at a path. Missing parts of the path are created.

- Signature: `json_set(source, mode, path, value, typed)`
- Output: Edited JSON (e.g. `edited_json = …`)

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | text | `""` | JSON · e.g. empty = a new object |
| `mode` | choice | `"set"` | What to do · `"set"` Set value, `"append"` Append to the array, `"remove"` Delete |
| `path` | text | `""` | Path · e.g. user.name or tags |
| `value` | text | `""` | Value · *only when `mode` is "set" / "append"* |
| `typed` | true/false | `true` | Numbers and true / false as values (not text) · *only when `mode` is "set" / "append"* |

#### `type_of` – Get type / Zjistit typ

Tells whether a value is a number, text, object, list, yes/no or empty.

- Signature: `type_of(value, names)`
- Output: Type (e.g. `type = …`)

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | text | `input` | Value |
| `names` | choice | `"cs"` | Naming · `"cs"` Czech (číslo, text, objekt…), `"en"` English (number, string, object…) |

<details><summary>Help</summary>

```text
Returns what kind of value it is:
• number – 42, -1,5, 1e3
• text – anything else
• object – JSON {…}
• list – JSON array […]
• yes/no – true or false
• empty – nothing, spaces or null

Useful in an If condition: If type is equal to “list”…
```

</details>

#### `list` – List operations / Práce se seznamem

Count, item by position, joining into text, splitting text into a list, appending, sorting… A list is a JSON array or one item per line; the resulting list is a JSON array.

- Signature: `list(source, op, index, separator, value)`
- Output: List result (e.g. `list_result = …`)

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | text | `input` | List / text |
| `op` | choice | `"count"` | Operation · `"count"` Number of items, `"sum"` Sum of numbers, `"avg"` Average of numbers, `"min"` Smallest number, `"max"` Largest number, `"item"` Item at position, `"first"` First item, `"last"` Last item, `"join"` Join into text, `"split"` Split text into a list, `"add"` Append an item, `"remove"` Remove the item at position, `"contains"` Contains the item (true / false), `"unique"` Without duplicates, `"sort"` Sort, `"reverse"` Reverse the order, `"shuffle"` Shuffle, `"random"` Random item, `"lines"` Convert to lines |
| `index` | text | `1` | Position (from 1, -1 = last) · *only when `op` is "item" / "remove"* |
| `separator` | text | `", "` | Separator · e.g. empty = new line · *only when `op` is "join" / "split"* |
| `value` | text | `""` | Item · *only when `op` is "add" / "contains"* |

<details><summary>Help</summary>

```text
A list is a JSON array or a text with one item per line.
The resulting list is always a JSON array.

• Item at position – counted from 1, -1 is the last
• Split text – by a separator (empty = new line)
• Sum, average, minimum, maximum – numbers only
• Sort – numbers by value, text alphabetically
```

</details>

#### `http_request` – HTTP request (API) / HTTP požadavek (API)

Calls an API: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE with headers and a body (JSON, form, files / images via multipart). Returns a response object {status, ok, headers, body}; you then take what you need from it (e.g. body.items[*].url) with the Get from JSON block.

- Signature: `http_request(method, url, headers, body_type, body, fields, file, content_type, only_body, save_file, fail)`
- Output: API response (e.g. `api_response = …`)

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `method` | choice | `"GET"` | Method · `"GET"` GET – read, `"POST"` POST – send, `"PUT"` PUT – replace, `"PATCH"` PATCH – update, `"DELETE"` DELETE – delete |
| `url` | text | `""` | Address · e.g. https://api.example.com/items |
| `headers` | text | `""` | Headers (key: value per line) · e.g. Authorization: Bearer … |
| `body_type` | choice | `"none"` | Body · `"none"` None, `"json"` JSON, `"form"` Form (key=value), `"multipart"` Multipart – text and files / images, `"text"` Custom text, `"file"` A whole file · *only when `method` is "POST" / "PUT" / "PATCH" / "DELETE"* |
| `body` | text | `""` | Body content · e.g. {"title": "Hello"} · *only when `method` is "POST" / "PUT" / "PATCH" / "DELETE" and `body_type` is "json" / "text"* |
| `fields` | text | `""` | Fields (key=value per line, a file as key=@file) · e.g. name=Jan ⏎ photo=@content://… · *only when `method` is "POST" / "PUT" / "PATCH" / "DELETE" and `body_type` is "form" / "multipart"* |
| `file` | text | `""` | File · e.g. output of the Pick file block · *only when `method` is "POST" / "PUT" / "PATCH" / "DELETE" and `body_type` is "file"* |
| `content_type` | text (plain) | `"text/plain; charset=utf-8"` | Content-Type · *only when `method` is "POST" / "PUT" / "PATCH" / "DELETE" and `body_type` is "text"* |
| `only_body` | true/false | `false` | Return only the response body (instead of the whole object) |
| `save_file` | true/false | `false` | Save the response as a file (e.g. an image) |
| `fail` | true/false | `true` | Error when the server returns 4xx / 5xx |

<details><summary>Help</summary>

```text
The result is an object:
{
  "status": 200,
  "ok": true,
  "headers": { "content-type": … },
  "body": … (JSON as JSON, otherwise text),
  "file": "file://…" (only when saved to a file)
}
Take values from it with the Get from JSON block: status, body.items[0].url…

Headers: one per line, Authorization: Bearer 🔑token
(insert the key as a secret value, it never gets into an export).

Body
• JSON – JSON text or the output of the Create JSON block
• Form – key=value lines
• Multipart – key=value, a file as photo=@output of the Pick file block
• A whole file – sends the file as the body

On a 4xx / 5xx error the action ends, unless you turn off “Error when
the server returns…” or put the step into a Try block.
```

</details>

### Images

#### `image_edit` – Edit image / Upravit obrázek

One image edit: shrink, rotate, flip, crop to a square, or convert to JPG / PNG / WEBP. Returns a new file – add another block for another edit.

- Signature: `image_edit(source, op, max_size, angle, flip, format, quality)`
- Output: Edited image (e.g. `edited_image = …`)

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | text | `""` | Image · e.g. output of the Pick file block, a downloaded file or an https:// address |
| `op` | choice | `"resize"` | Edit · `"resize"` Shrink, `"rotate"` Rotate, `"flip"` Flip (mirror), `"square"` Crop to a square (center), `"convert"` Convert format |
| `max_size` | number | `1600` | Longer side at most · 100–4000 px · *only when `op` is "resize"* |
| `angle` | choice | `"90"` | Rotate by · `"90"` 90° right, `"180"` 180°, `"270"` 90° left · *only when `op` is "rotate"* |
| `flip` | choice | `"horizontal"` | Direction · `"horizontal"` Horizontally (left to right), `"vertical"` Vertically (top to bottom) · *only when `op` is "flip"* |
| `format` | choice | `"jpeg"` | Format · `"jpeg"` JPG, `"png"` PNG (lossless), `"webp"` WEBP · *only when `op` is "convert"* |
| `quality` | number | `85` | Quality · 10–100 % · *only when `op` is "convert" and `format` is "jpeg" / "webp"* |

#### `image_info` – Image information / Informace o obrázku

Width, height, file size and type of an image – for an "is greater than" condition, say.

- Signature: `image_info(source, what)`
- Output: Image value (e.g. `image_value = …`)

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | text | `""` | Image · e.g. output of the Pick file block, a downloaded file or an https:// address |
| `what` | choice | `"all"` | What to get · `"all"` Everything as JSON (width, height, bytes, type, name), `"width"` Width (px), `"height"` Height (px), `"bytes"` File size (bytes), `"kb"` File size (kB), `"type"` Type (image/jpeg…) |

#### `take_photo` – Take a photo / Vyfotit

Opens the camera and returns the photo taken. It can then be edited, sent over HTTP, saved, or read for a QR code with the Read code from image block.

- Signature: `take_photo()`
- Output: Photo (e.g. `photo = …`)
- Shows something on screen

#### `qr_create` – Create QR code / Vytvořit QR kód

Makes a picture with a QR code from a text or a link. Show it with the Show images block, share it or save it.

- Signature: `qr_create(text, size)`
- Output: QR code (e.g. `qr_code = …`)

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | text | `input` | Text or link |
| `size` | number | `800` | Size · 200–1600 px |

#### `qr_read` – Read code from image / Přečíst kód z obrázku

Finds a QR or bar code in a picture and returns what it holds. The picture comes from Take a photo, Pick file / image or an https:// link.

- Signature: `qr_read(image)`
- Output: Code content (e.g. `code_content = …`)

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `image` | text | `""` | Image · e.g. output of Take a photo / Pick image |

<details><summary>Help</summary>

```text
Finds a QR code or a bar code (EAN, Code 128…) in a picture and
returns what it holds.

Another block supplies the picture:
• Take a photo – aim at the code and take the picture
• Pick file / image – a screenshot or a photo from the gallery
• the https://… address of a picture on the web

The output is the text of the code: open a link with the Open link
block, send a product number to an API…
```

</details>

### Dialogs

#### `ask_text` – Ask for text / Zeptat se na text

Shows a dialog with a text field. Cancelling the dialog ends the action.

- Signature: `ask_text(title, initial, multiline)`
- Output: Entered text (e.g. `entered_text = …`)
- Shows something on screen

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | text | `"Zadej text"` | Question |
| `initial` | text | `""` | Prefilled · e.g. nic |
| `multiline` | true/false | `false` | Multiple lines |

#### `choose` – Choose from a list / Vybrat z nabídky

Offers options (each on its own line, or a JSON array) and returns the chosen one.

- Signature: `choose(title, options, label)`
- Output: Chosen item (e.g. `chosen_item = …`)
- Shows something on screen

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | text | `"Vyber"` | Title |
| `options` | text | `"Ano\nNe"` | Options (one per line) |
| `label` | text | `""` | For a list of objects show · e.g. a path, e.g. title or user.name – the whole object is returned |

#### `show_text` – Show text / Ukázat text

Shows a text in a dialog it can be copied from. The action continues after it is closed.

- Signature: `show_text(title, text)`
- Shows something on screen

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | text | `"Výsledek"` | Title |
| `text` | text | `input` | Text |

#### `pick_file` – Pick file / image / Vybrat soubor / obrázek

Lets you pick an image or a file. The output can be edited with the Edit image block, sent in an HTTP request (field=@output) or shown with the Show images block.

- Signature: `pick_file(kind)`
- Output: Picked file (e.g. `picked_file = …`)
- Shows something on screen

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | choice | `"image/*"` | What to pick · `"image/*"` Image, `"video/*"` Video, `"*/*"` Any file |

#### `show_images` – Show images / Ukázat obrázky

Shows images from addresses (a JSON array or one per line), picked or downloaded files. It can let you choose one.

- Signature: `show_images(title, images, pick)`
- Output: Chosen image (e.g. `chosen_image = …`)
- Shows something on screen

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | text | `"Obrázky"` | Title |
| `images` | text | `input` | Images |
| `pick` | true/false | `false` | Let me choose one |

#### `show_web` – Show web page in a window / Ukázat web v okně

Opens a web page in a window right in the app and waits until you close it. The output is the address you ended on – handy after a sign-in that redirects you. The script runs in every loaded page; when it calls done(value), the window closes and that value is the output.

- Signature: `show_web(url, title, script)`
- Output: Result or address (e.g. `result_or_address = …`)
- Shows something on screen

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | text | `input` | Page address · e.g. https://… |
| `title` | text | `""` | Title · e.g. optional |
| `script` | code | `""` | JavaScript after the page loads · e.g. if (location.pathname == '/hotovo') done(document.title) |

#### `pick_save_file` – File to write to / Soubor pro zápis

Asks where to write: create a new file (CSV, JSON or text) or pick an existing one. The format of a new file can be set in advance (csv, json, txt – a variable works too), otherwise it asks. The app may write into the chosen file later as well – keep the output with the Store value block, take it with Load value next time and there is no need to ask again. The output goes into the blocks Write to file and Add record to file.

- Signature: `pick_save_file(format, name)`
- Output: File to write to (e.g. `file_to_write_to = …`)

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | text | `""` | Format of the new file · e.g. ask · common: `csv`, `json`, `txt` |
| `name` | text | `"zaznam"` | Name of the new file |

#### `dictate` – Dictate text / Nadiktovat text

Opens speech recognition and returns what you said. Handy instead of typing: dictate and pass it on.

- Signature: `dictate(prompt, language)`
- Output: Dictated text (e.g. `dictated_text = …`)
- Shows something on screen

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | text | `""` | Prompt · e.g. what to say (optional) |
| `language` | text (plain) | `""` | Language · e.g. the phone's (cs, en, de…) |

### Variables

#### `set_variable` – Set variable / Nastavit proměnnou

Stores a value under a name. You then insert the variable into later steps.

- Signature: `set_variable(name, value)`

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | text (plain) | `"promenna"` | Name |
| `value` | text | `input` | Value |

#### `store_set` – Store value / Uložit hodnotu

Remembers a value even after the action ends (the last ID from an API, say), so the next run can compare it. It belongs to this automation only, unless you set it as shared. Values stay on the phone and are not exported.

- Signature: `store_set(mode, key, value, scope)`

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | choice | `"set"` | What to do · `"set"` Save, `"remove"` Delete |
| `key` | text | `""` | Name · e.g. last_id |
| `value` | text | `""` | Value · *only when `mode` is "set"* |
| `scope` | choice | `"own"` | Scope · `"own"` Only for this automation, `"shared"` Shared with all automations |

<details><summary>Help</summary>

```text
The value stays stored after the action ends; the next run reads it
with the Load value block.

• Only for this automation (default) – every automation has its own,
  names like last_state do not overwrite each other
• Shared – one value for all automations

Stored values can be seen and edited in the automation's settings
(shared ones in the app's Settings).
```

</details>

#### `store_get` – Load value / Načíst hodnotu

Returns a value stored by the Store value block (also from an earlier run) – of this automation, or a shared one.

- Signature: `store_get(key, fallback, scope)`
- Output: Stored value (e.g. `stored_value = …`)

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | text | `""` | Name · e.g. last_id |
| `fallback` | text | `""` | When nothing is stored · e.g. empty text |
| `scope` | choice | `"own"` | Scope · `"own"` Only for this automation, `"shared"` Shared with all automations |

#### `change_variable` – Change variable / Změnit proměnnou

Adds a number, appends a text or adds an item to a list in a variable – in one step, so nothing gets lost even when several parallel rounds do it at once. The output is the new value.

- Signature: `change_variable(name, op, value)`
- Output: New value (e.g. `new_value = …`)

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | text (plain) | `"soucet"` | Name |
| `op` | choice | `"add"` | What to do · `"add"` Add a number, `"append"` Append text to the end, `"push"` Add an item to a list |
| `value` | text | `input` | Value |

<details><summary>Help</summary>

```text
Changes a variable based on what is in it – in one step.

• Add a number – an empty variable counts as 0; subtract with a negative number
• Append text to the end
• Add an item to a list – the variable becomes a JSON array

Unlike the pair "Calculate + Set variable" nothing fits between
reading and saving, so it works in a parallel loop too: ten rounds can
add to one sum at once and nothing gets lost.

When you need several steps with the variable at once (read, decide,
save), put them into the One at a time block.
```

</details>

### Conditions and control

#### `if` – If / Pokud

Runs the following steps only when the condition holds. It can have an Otherwise branch.

- Signature: `if(mode, left, op, right, expression)`
- Group: the steps up to `end`

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | choice | `"simple"` | Notation · `"simple"` Simple – a value and a condition, `"expert"` Expression – and / or, numbers, functions |
| `left` | text | `input` | Value · *only when `mode` is "simple"* |
| `op` | choice | `"equals"` | Condition · `"equals"` is equal to, `"not_equals"` is not equal to, `"contains"` contains, `"not_contains"` does not contain, `"starts"` starts with, `"ends"` ends with, `"matches"` matches the regular expression, `"empty"` is empty, `"not_empty"` is not empty, `"greater"` is greater than, `"less"` is less than, `"greater_eq"` is greater than or equal to, `"less_eq"` is less than or equal to · *only when `mode` is "simple"* |
| `right` | text | `""` | Compare with · e.g. hodnota · *only when `mode` is "simple" and `op` is "equals" / "not_equals" / "contains" / "not_contains" / "starts" / "ends" / "matches" / "greater" / "less" / "greater_eq" / "less_eq"* |
| `expression` | text | `""` | Expression · e.g. battery < 20 or state == "vip" · *only when `mode` is "expert"* |

<details><summary>Help</summary>

```text
Simple notation: a value, a condition and what to compare with.

Expression – the condition written as text, when you need more things
at once. Insert variables with the { } button or write them by name
(those from the Set variable block).

• comparison: == != < <= > >=
• joining: a and b, a or b, not a (also && / || / !)
• numbers are compared as numbers: "10" > 9 holds
• texts in quotes: state == "ok"
• functions: contains(text, "x"), len(list) > 0, starts(url, "https")

Examples
• battery < 20 and not charging
• state == "vip" or price > 500
• len(response.body.items) == 0

Branches: add Otherwise if (another condition) and Otherwise in the
⋮ menu. The whole language is described in the help of the Script block.
```

</details>

#### `while` – Repeat while / Opakuj dokud

Repeats the following steps while the condition holds.

- Signature: `while(mode, left, op, right, expression)`
- Group: the steps up to `end`

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | choice | `"simple"` | Notation · `"simple"` Simple – a value and a condition, `"expert"` Expression – and / or, numbers, functions |
| `left` | text | `input` | Value · *only when `mode` is "simple"* |
| `op` | choice | `"equals"` | Condition · `"equals"` is equal to, `"not_equals"` is not equal to, `"contains"` contains, `"not_contains"` does not contain, `"starts"` starts with, `"ends"` ends with, `"matches"` matches the regular expression, `"empty"` is empty, `"not_empty"` is not empty, `"greater"` is greater than, `"less"` is less than, `"greater_eq"` is greater than or equal to, `"less_eq"` is less than or equal to · *only when `mode` is "simple"* |
| `right` | text | `""` | Compare with · e.g. hodnota · *only when `mode` is "simple" and `op` is "equals" / "not_equals" / "contains" / "not_contains" / "starts" / "ends" / "matches" / "greater" / "less" / "greater_eq" / "less_eq"* |
| `expression` | text | `""` | Expression · e.g. battery < 20 or state == "vip" · *only when `mode` is "expert"* |

<details><summary>Help</summary>

```text
Simple notation: a value, a condition and what to compare with.

Expression – the condition written as text, when you need more things
at once. Insert variables with the { } button or write them by name
(those from the Set variable block).

• comparison: == != < <= > >=
• joining: a and b, a or b, not a (also && / || / !)
• numbers are compared as numbers: "10" > 9 holds
• texts in quotes: state == "ok"
• functions: contains(text, "x"), len(list) > 0, starts(url, "https")

Examples
• battery < 20 and not charging
• state == "vip" or price > 500
• len(response.body.items) == 0

Branches: add Otherwise if (another condition) and Otherwise in the
⋮ menu. The whole language is described in the help of the Script block.
```

</details>

#### `try` – Try / Zkusit

When a step inside fails (an API or the network, say), the action does not end: it tries again, or continues in the On failure branch. The output is the error text (empty when everything passed).

- Signature: `try(attempts, delay, backoff)`
- Output: Error (e.g. `error = …`)
- Group: marker lines, see *Groups that exist only as blocks*

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `attempts` | number | `1` | Attempts in total · 1–10 × |
| `delay` | number | `2` | Pause before the next attempt · 0–60 s · *only for some values of `attempts` (more than 1)* |
| `backoff` | true/false | `false` | Double the pause every time · *only for some values of `attempts` (more than 1)* |

<details><summary>Help</summary>

```text
When a step inside fails (network, API, invalid JSON…), the action does not end.

• Attempts in total – how many times to try the steps before giving up
• Pause – how many seconds to wait before the next attempt
• Double the pause every time – 2 s, 4 s, 8 s…, to give the server time to recover
• On failure – steps that run after the last failed attempt
• the output of the Try block is the error text (empty when all passed)

Try can be nested and put into loops. With a Time limit block inside
it makes "try this for 10 s at most, otherwise do something else".
```

</details>

#### `wait` – Wait / Počkat

Pauses the action for the given time – seconds, minutes or hours.

- Signature: `wait(seconds, unit)`

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `seconds` | number | `1` | Time · 0–60 |
| `unit` | choice | `"s"` | Unit · `"s"` seconds, `"min"` minutes, `"h"` hours |

#### `return` – Return result / Vrátit výsledek

Ends the action and returns a text. When started from a text selection it replaces the selected text, otherwise the result is copied to the clipboard.

- Signature: `return(text)`

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | text | `input` | Result |

#### `for_each` – For each item / Pro každou položku

Repeats the steps for every item of a list (a JSON array or one item per line). The current item is the output of this step.

- Signature: `for_each(list, parallel, limit, gap, collect)`
- Output: Item (e.g. `item = …`)
- Group: the steps up to `end`

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `list` | text | `input` | List |
| `parallel` | true/false | `false` | In parallel (all rounds at once) |
| `limit` | number | `5` | Rounds at once, at most · 1–50 · *only when `parallel` is true* |
| `gap` | number | `0` | Pause between the starts of rounds · 0–10 s · *only when `parallel` is true* |
| `collect` | text (plain) | `""` | Save the rounds' results to variable · e.g. name (optional) · *only when `parallel` is true* |

<details><summary>Help</summary>

```text
The list can be a JSON array ["a", "b"] or a text with one item per line.

The output of the block is the current item. For an array of objects it is
the whole object – take its parts with the Get from JSON block.

Which round is running tells the Loop position block. End the loop or
skip a round with the End loop / skip round block.

In parallel: all rounds run at the same time (at most as many as you
set) – ten API calls instead of waiting for one after another. Every
round has its own item, its own Loop position and its own step
outputs, so the rounds do not mix. Variables (Set variable) are
shared though and the rounds overwrite them. Add up with the Change
variable block, or put the "read, compute, save" steps into One at a
time.

Get the results with "Save the rounds' results to variable": after the
end it holds a list with the output of the last step of every round,
in the order of the items.

Ending the loop in one round ends all of it: the other rounds stop
and the steps after the loop hold the values of that round – "the
first one to find it wins". An error in one round stops the others
the same way and is an error of the whole loop; to let a round
survive it, put its steps into Try. The pause between the starts of
the rounds spreads requests in time when an API limits how many may
come per second.
```

</details>

#### `repeat` – Repeat several times / Opakovat několikrát

Repeats the steps the given number of times. The output is the number of the current round (from 1).

- Signature: `repeat(count, parallel, limit, gap, collect)`
- Output: Round (e.g. `round = …`)
- Group: the steps up to `end`

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `count` | text | `3` | How many times |
| `parallel` | true/false | `false` | In parallel (all rounds at once) |
| `limit` | number | `5` | Rounds at once, at most · 1–50 · *only when `parallel` is true* |
| `gap` | number | `0` | Pause between the starts of rounds · 0–10 s · *only when `parallel` is true* |
| `collect` | text (plain) | `""` | Save the rounds' results to variable · e.g. name (optional) · *only when `parallel` is true* |

<details><summary>Help</summary>

```text
The output of the block is the number of the round (from 1).

In parallel: all rounds run at the same time (at most as many as you
set) – ten API calls instead of waiting for one after another. Every
round has its own item, its own Loop position and its own step
outputs, so the rounds do not mix. Variables (Set variable) are
shared though and the rounds overwrite them. Add up with the Change
variable block, or put the "read, compute, save" steps into One at a
time.

Get the results with "Save the rounds' results to variable": after the
end it holds a list with the output of the last step of every round,
in the order of the items.

Ending the loop in one round ends all of it: the other rounds stop
and the steps after the loop hold the values of that round – "the
first one to find it wins". An error in one round stops the others
the same way and is an error of the whole loop; to let a round
survive it, put its steps into Try. The pause between the starts of
the rounds spreads requests in time when an API limits how many may
come per second.
```

</details>

#### `loop_control` – End loop / skip round / Ukončit / přeskočit kolo

Inside a loop: ends the whole loop, or skips the rest of the steps and continues with the next round.

- Signature: `loop_control(action)`

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | choice | `"break"` | What to do · `"break"` End the loop, `"continue"` Continue with the next round |

#### `loop_index` – Loop position / Pořadí v opakování

Which round of the nearest loop (For each item, Repeat, Repeat while) is running right now.

- Signature: `loop_index(zero)`
- Output: Position (e.g. `position = …`)

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `zero` | true/false | `false` | Count from 0 |

#### `script` – Script / Skript

A few lines of code instead of many blocks: calculations, conditions (and / or), loops, working with texts, lists and JSON. It reads and sets the automation's variables. Help under ?.

- Signature: `script(code)`
- Output: Script result (e.g. `script_result = …`)

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | code | `""` | Code · e.g. total = price * 1.21 ⏎ if total > 500 ⏎     return "expensive" ⏎ end ⏎ return round(total, 2) |

<details><summary>Help</summary>

```text
A short program. The result of the block is the value after return, or
the result of the last line. Variables are shared with the Set variable
block: what the script sets, later steps see, and the other way round.
Insert values of other steps with the { } button; the automation's
input is input.

Values
• numbers 12 and 1.5 (decimal point), texts "hello" or 'hello'
• true / false, null (an empty value)
• a list [1, 2, 3], an object {name: "Jan", age: 30}
• a text with JSON (an API response, say) acts as a list / object

Operations
• + - * / % (remainder) ^ (power), parentheses
• & joins texts: "Hello " & name
• == != < <= > >=
• and, or, not (also &&, ||, !)

Statements (English or Czech)
• x = 5, x += 1, list[0] = "a", person.age = 31
• if condition … else if … else … end
• while condition … end
• for item in list … end
• break (ends the loop), continue (next round)
• return value
• # a note to the end of the line

Reading data
• list[0] the first, list[-1] the last
• response.body.items[0].title

Built-in variables
• input, clipboard, trigger
• event("wifi_name"), secret("name")

Functions – text
• len(x), upper(x), lower(x), trim(x)
• replace(text, what, with), contains(text, what)
• ==, contains, starts and ends ignore upper / lower case
  (like the If block); exact(a, b) compares exactly
• starts(text, start), ends(text, end)
• split(text, separator), join(list, separator)
• substr(text, from, length), find(text, what)
• match(text, regex), matches(text, regex)

Functions – numbers
• round(x, places), floor(x), ceil(x), abs(x), sqrt(x)
• min(…), max(…), sum(list), avg(list)
• num(text), int(x), random(from, to)
• calc("1 000 * 1,21") – the calculator of the Calculate block

Functions – lists and others
• range(5) → 1 to 5, range(2, 4)
• push(list, x), keys(object), values(object)
• json(text), tojson(value), type(x)
• iif(condition, a, b), date("d. M. yyyy"), now()
• var("name with a space") – a variable that cannot be written by name

Blocks as functions
Every block can be called by its type. Write parameters by name in { },
or one after another in the order they have in the block.
• res = http_request({url: "https://api.example.com/items"})
• toast("Done: " & len(res.body.items))
• set_clipboard(result), vibrate(300)
• ask_text({title: "Name?"}), open_app("Spotify")
• block("replace", {source: t, find: "a", replacement: "b"}) – for
  blocks named like a function (replace, text, random)
The automation's settings → Show as script writes your steps this
way, so you can see every block's type and parameters.

Example
total = 0
for p in response.body.items
    if p.price > 100
        total += p.price
    end
end
return "Total " & round(total, 2)
```

</details>

#### `run_automation` – Run automation / Spustit automatizaci

Runs another automation as a subroutine: passes it an input, waits and returns what it returned with the Return result block. Write a thing once, use it many times.

- Signature: `run_automation(automation, input)`
- Output: Automation result (e.g. `automation_result = …`)

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `automation` | automation id | `""` | Automations · the number of another automation on the phone, "" = none |
| `input` | text | `input` | Input for the automation |

#### `wait_until` – Wait until / Počkat dokud

Waits until the condition starts to hold – until the phone connects to Wi-Fi or the clipboard changes, say. The value is read again every few seconds. Returns true, or false when the time runs out.

- Signature: `wait_until(left, op, right, timeout, interval, fail)`
- Output: It happened (e.g. `it_happened = …`)

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `left` | text | `""` | Value · e.g. insert a variable that changes |
| `op` | choice | `"equals"` | Condition · `"equals"` is equal to, `"not_equals"` is not equal to, `"contains"` contains, `"not_contains"` does not contain, `"empty"` is empty, `"not_empty"` is not empty, `"greater"` is greater than, `"less"` is less than, `"greater_eq"` is greater than or equal to, `"less_eq"` is less than or equal to |
| `right` | text | `""` | Compare with · e.g. hodnota · *only when `op` is "equals" / "not_equals" / "contains" / "not_contains" / "greater" / "less" / "greater_eq" / "less_eq"* |
| `timeout` | number | `60` | Wait at most · 5–600 s |
| `interval` | number | `2` | Check every · 1–60 s |
| `fail` | true/false | `false` | Error when it does not happen |

#### `switch` – Choose by / Vyber podle

Runs one of the When it is branches by a value. Clearer than a row of If / Otherwise if when you keep comparing the same value. Add more branches in the ⋮ menu.

- Signature: `switch(value)`
- Group: the steps up to `end`

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | text | `input` | Value |

#### `parallel` – In parallel / Souběžně

The branches inside run at the same time and the run goes on when all are done – two API calls instead of waiting for one after the other, say. An error in a branch is an error of the whole block.

- Signature: `parallel()`
- Group: marker lines, see *Groups that exist only as blocks*

#### `lock` – One at a time / Jeden po druhém

The steps inside are done by one round or branch at a time – the others wait for their turn. Put "read the variable, compute, save" here when rounds run in parallel, otherwise they overwrite it.

- Signature: `lock(name)`
- Group: marker lines, see *Groups that exist only as blocks*

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | text (plain) | `""` | Lock name · e.g. empty = the shared lock |

<details><summary>Help</summary>

```text
The steps inside are done by one round or branch at a time. The
others that reach the block wait until the one before them is done.

Why: rounds running in parallel share variables. When two rounds read
the sum 10 at once, both add their number and save, one addition is
lost. Inside One at a time that cannot happen.

Example – a sum from several APIs at once
• For each item (in parallel)
•     HTTP request, Get from JSON → price
•     One at a time
•         Calculate total + price
•         Set variable total
•     End of One at a time
• End of loop

Leave slow steps (HTTP request) outside – inside the rounds would wait
for each other and running in parallel would be pointless. Only the
short part that works with the shared variable belongs inside.

Lock name: blocks with the same name take turns together, blocks with
different names do not wait for each other. An empty name is one
shared lock.

For a single addition, appending a text or adding to a list the
Change variable block is enough – it needs no lock.
```

</details>

#### `time_limit` – Time limit / Časový limit

The steps inside have to finish within the given time, otherwise they fail. A Try block can catch that – e.g. "try this for 10 s at most, otherwise do something else".

- Signature: `time_limit(seconds)`
- Group: marker lines, see *Groups that exist only as blocks*

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `seconds` | number | `10` | At most · 1–300 s |

<details><summary>Help</summary>

```text
The steps inside have to finish within the given time. When they do
not, they are stopped and the block fails with "the steps did not
finish".

Catch the error with a Try block around it – and do something else in
the On failure branch (try a backup server, report it…).

While stepping through in the editor the limit does not count, so you
can look at the steps in peace.
```

</details>

#### `fail` – Stop with error / Zastavit s chybou

Ends the action with an error of your own. Inside a Try block the On failure branch catches it.

- Signature: `fail(message)`

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `message` | text | `"Něco se nepovedlo"` | Error text |

#### `comment` – Note / Poznámka

Does nothing – just a label of what the following steps do.

- Signature: `comment(text)`

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | text (plain) | `""` | Note · e.g. what the next steps do |
