#### `location` – Get location / Zjistit polohu

Where the phone is right now. As the text "latitude,longitude" (goes straight into a map link), or as JSON with latitude, longitude and accuracy to take the values from with the Get from JSON block.

- Signature: `location(format)`
- Output: Location (e.g. `location_result = …`)
- Requires: Location access – Without it the app cannot find where the phone is.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | choice | `"coords"` | Output · `"coords"` latitude,longitude, `"json"` JSON (lat, lon, accuracy) |

<details><summary>Help</summary>

```text
Finds where the phone is right now (Wi-Fi, cell towers, GPS – whatever
is at hand). When no new position comes within 15 s, the last known
one is returned.

• latitude,longitude – e.g. 50.075500,14.437800; put it straight into
  the link https://maps.google.com/?q=… or into geo:
• JSON – {"lat":…, "lon":…, "accuracy":…}; accuracy is in metres,
  take the values with the Get from JSON block

The Address from location block turns coordinates into an address.

From events in the background it needs location allowed "All the time".
```

</details>

#### `address_of` – Address from location / Adresa z polohy

Turns coordinates (the output of Get location, or "50.08,14.42") into an address. Needs the internet.

- Signature: `address_of(coords)`
- Output: Address (e.g. `address = …`)

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `coords` | text | `""` | Coordinates · e.g. 50.08,14.42 |

#### `media` – Control playback / Ovládat přehrávání

Sends the player (music, podcast, video) what the buttons on headphones do: play, pause, next.

- Signature: `media(action)`

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | choice | `"toggle"` | What to do · `"toggle"` Play / pause, `"play"` Play, `"pause"` Pause, `"next"` Next track, `"previous"` Previous track, `"stop"` Stop |

#### `brightness` – Set brightness / Nastavit jas

Sets the display brightness to the chosen level, or puts it back to automatic.

- Signature: `brightness(mode, level)`
- Requires: Changing system settings – Without it the app may not change the display brightness.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | choice | `"manual"` | Brightness · `"manual"` Set a level, `"auto"` Automatic |
| `level` | number | `50` | Level · 0–100 % · *only when `mode` is "manual"* |

#### `dnd` – Do Not Disturb mode / Režim Nerušit

Turns Do not disturb on or off. What gets through in "priority only" is set in the phone's settings.

- Signature: `dnd(mode)`
- Requires: Do Not Disturb access – Without it the ringer cannot be switched to silent and the volume cannot be changed during Do Not Disturb.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | choice | `"off"` | Mode · `"off"` Off (everything gets through), `"priority"` Priority only, `"alarms"` Alarms only, `"none"` Total silence |

#### `nfc_write` – Write to NFC tag / Zapsat na NFC štítek

Waits for you to hold a tag to the phone and writes a text or a link on it. With the app mark the phone hands the tag straight to the NFC tag scanned event, without asking and without a browser.

- Signature: `nfc_write(content, open_here)`
- Output: Tag ID (e.g. `tag_id = …`)
- Shows something on screen

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `content` | text | `""` | Text or link · e.g. may stay empty |
| `open_here` | true/false | `true` | Add this app's mark |

### App

#### `open_app` – Open the app / Otevřít aplikaci

Starts an installed app – like tapping its icon. A name (Spotify) or a package (com.spotify.music) is enough.

- Signature: `open_app(app)`
- Shows something on screen

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `app` | text | `""` | App · e.g. name or package · an app name or package |

#### `send_intent` – Send intent / start service / Poslat intent / spustit službu

For advanced users: opens a specific screen of another app, starts its service or sends it a message (broadcast) – with an action, data and parameters (extras). This is how apps that support it are controlled (Tasker plugins, players, smart home…). Help under ?.

- Signature: `send_intent(target, package, class, action, data, mime, extras)`

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | choice | `"activity"` | What to do · `"activity"` Open a screen (activity), `"service"` Start a service, `"foreground_service"` Start a foreground service, `"broadcast"` Send a message (broadcast) |
| `package` | text | `""` | App (package) · e.g. com.example.app · an app name or package |
| `class` | text | `""` | Class (optional) · e.g. com.example.app.SyncService or .SyncService |
| `action` | text | `""` | Action · e.g. android.intent.action.VIEW · common: `android.intent.action.VIEW`, `android.intent.action.SEND`, `android.intent.action.MAIN`, `android.intent.action.SEARCH`, `android.intent.action.WEB_SEARCH`, `android.intent.action.DIAL`, `android.intent.action.SENDTO`, `android.intent.action.EDIT`, `android.media.action.MEDIA_PLAY_FROM_SEARCH` |
| `data` | text | `""` | Data (address) · e.g. https://… or spotify:track:… |
| `mime` | text | `""` | Data type (MIME) · e.g. text/plain |
| `extras` | text | `""` | Parameters – extras (name=value per line) · e.g. query=hello ⏎ count:int=5 |

<details><summary>Help</summary>

```text
An intent is a message for another app. What exactly to send is in that
app's documentation (look for “intent”, “Tasker” or “automation”).

What to do
• Open a screen – a specific window of the app (activity)
• Start a service – background work; the app must allow starting it
  from outside (exported), otherwise Android returns an error
• Start a foreground service – when Android refuses a plain start
• Send a broadcast – a message the app waits for

Fields
• Package – com.example.app (can be picked from a list)
• Class – the full name, or shortened .SyncService; the button under
  the field lists what the chosen app allows
• Action – e.g. android.intent.action.VIEW
• Data – an address: https://…, tel:123, spotify:track:…

Parameters (extras), one per line
• query=hello → text
• count=5 → whole number, enabled=true → yes/no, ratio=1.5 → decimal
• the type can be forced: id:long=5, name:string=123, x:float=1.5,
  y:double=2.5, n:int=1, on:bool=true

Examples
• Open a screen, action android.intent.action.VIEW,
  data geo:0,0?q=Prague → a map
• Send a broadcast, the app's package, an action from its documentation
```

</details>

### Other

#### `toast` – Show message / Zobrazit zprávu

Shows a short message at the bottom of the screen.

- Signature: `toast(text)`

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | text | `input` | Message |

#### `open_url` – Open link / Otevřít odkaz

Opens a web address or another link (tel:, mailto:, geo:…).

- Signature: `open_url(url)`
- Shows something on screen

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | text | `""` | Address · e.g. https://… |

#### `date` – Date and time / Datum a čas

The current date in the chosen format (e.g. d. M. yyyy, HH:mm, EEEE).

- Signature: `block("date", format)`
- Output: Date (e.g. `date_result = …`)

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | text (plain) | `"d. M. yyyy HH:mm"` | Format |

#### `notification` – Notification with buttons / Oznámení s tlačítky

Shows a notification with up to three buttons: copy a text, run another automation, open a link or share a text. The texts are filled in when it is shown, so a button copies what the automation computed. A countdown can run in it and an automation can start when it ends.

- Signature: `notification(title, text, quiet, name, countdown, end_automation, end_input, b1_action, b1_label, b1_text, b1_automation, b1_input, b1_url, b2_action, b2_label, b2_text, b2_automation, b2_input, b2_url, b3_action, b3_label, b3_text, b3_automation, b3_input, b3_url)`
- Requires: Notifications – The app must be allowed to show notifications.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | text | `"Automatizace"` | Title |
| `text` | text | `input` | Text |
| `quiet` | true/false | `false` | Quiet (no sound, no pop-up) |
| `name` | text | `""` | Notification name · e.g. optional – the same name replaces the notification |
| `countdown` | text | `""` | Countdown · e.g. no countdown; seconds or 1:30 |
| `end_automation` | automation id | `""` | Run when it ends · the number of another automation on the phone, "" = none · *only when `countdown` is filled in* |
| `end_input` | text | `""` | Input for the automation · e.g. nic · *only when `countdown` is filled in* |
| `b1_action` | choice | `"copy"` | 1. tlačítko · `"none"` No button, `"copy"` Copy to the clipboard, `"run"` Run automation, `"url"` Open link, `"share"` Share text, `"dismiss"` Only close the notification |
| `b1_label` | text | `"Kopírovat"` | Button label · e.g. empty = by the action · *only when `b1_action` is "copy" / "run" / "url" / "share" / "dismiss"* |
| `b1_text` | text | `input` | Text · *only when `b1_action` is "copy" / "share"* |
| `b1_automation` | automation id | `""` | Automations · the number of another automation on the phone, "" = none · *only when `b1_action` is "run"* |
| `b1_input` | text | `""` | Input for the automation · e.g. nic · *only when `b1_action` is "run"* |
| `b1_url` | text | `""` | Address · e.g. https://… · *only when `b1_action` is "url"* |
| `b2_action` | choice | `"none"` | 2. tlačítko · `"none"` No button, `"copy"` Copy to the clipboard, `"run"` Run automation, `"url"` Open link, `"share"` Share text, `"dismiss"` Only close the notification · *only when `b1_action` is "copy" / "run" / "url" / "share" / "dismiss"* |
| `b2_label` | text | `""` | Button label · e.g. empty = by the action · *only when `b2_action` is "copy" / "run" / "url" / "share" / "dismiss" and `b1_action` is "copy" / "run" / "url" / "share" / "dismiss"* |
| `b2_text` | text | `""` | Text · *only when `b2_action` is "copy" / "share" and `b1_action` is "copy" / "run" / "url" / "share" / "dismiss"* |
| `b2_automation` | automation id | `""` | Automations · the number of another automation on the phone, "" = none · *only when `b2_action` is "run" and `b1_action` is "copy" / "run" / "url" / "share" / "dismiss"* |
| `b2_input` | text | `""` | Input for the automation · e.g. nic · *only when `b2_action` is "run" and `b1_action` is "copy" / "run" / "url" / "share" / "dismiss"* |
| `b2_url` | text | `""` | Address · e.g. https://… · *only when `b2_action` is "url" and `b1_action` is "copy" / "run" / "url" / "share" / "dismiss"* |
| `b3_action` | choice | `"none"` | 3. tlačítko · `"none"` No button, `"copy"` Copy to the clipboard, `"run"` Run automation, `"url"` Open link, `"share"` Share text, `"dismiss"` Only close the notification · *only when `b2_action` is "copy" / "run" / "url" / "share" / "dismiss" and `b1_action` is "copy" / "run" / "url" / "share" / "dismiss"* |
| `b3_label` | text | `""` | Button label · e.g. empty = by the action · *only when `b2_action` is "copy" / "run" / "url" / "share" / "dismiss" and `b3_action` is "copy" / "run" / "url" / "share" / "dismiss" and `b1_action` is "copy" / "run" / "url" / "share" / "dismiss"* |
| `b3_text` | text | `""` | Text · *only when `b2_action` is "copy" / "run" / "url" / "share" / "dismiss" and `b3_action` is "copy" / "share" and `b1_action` is "copy" / "run" / "url" / "share" / "dismiss"* |
| `b3_automation` | automation id | `""` | Automations · the number of another automation on the phone, "" = none · *only when `b2_action` is "copy" / "run" / "url" / "share" / "dismiss" and `b3_action` is "run" and `b1_action` is "copy" / "run" / "url" / "share" / "dismiss"* |
| `b3_input` | text | `""` | Input for the automation · e.g. nic · *only when `b2_action` is "copy" / "run" / "url" / "share" / "dismiss" and `b3_action` is "run" and `b1_action` is "copy" / "run" / "url" / "share" / "dismiss"* |
| `b3_url` | text | `""` | Address · e.g. https://… · *only when `b2_action` is "copy" / "run" / "url" / "share" / "dismiss" and `b3_action` is "url" and `b1_action` is "copy" / "run" / "url" / "share" / "dismiss"* |

#### `notification_cancel` – Cancel notification / Zrušit oznámení

Closes a notification by its name (the Notification name field of the Notification with buttons block) and cancels its countdown – what was to run at its end does not start.

- Signature: `notification_cancel(name)`

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | text | `""` | Notification name |

#### `notification_remaining` – Remaining countdown time / Zbývající čas odpočtu

How many seconds are left of the countdown in the notification of that name (0 when none runs). Handy for pausing: remember the rest, show the notification without a countdown and start it again with the rest later.

- Signature: `notification_remaining(name)`
- Output: Seconds left (e.g. `seconds_left = …`)

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Values / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | text | `""` | Notification name |

## 6. Examples from the app

Real automations that ship with the app, written by the app itself.

### UPPER CASE

Converts the selected or shared text to upper case.

```
# @name "UPPER CASE"
# @icon text
# @triggers process_text, share
text_result = change_case(input, "upper")
return text_result
```

### Clean the clipboard

A quick settings tile: tidies spaces and line breaks in the clipboard text.

```
# @name "Clean the clipboard"
# @icon paste
# @triggers tile
text_result = clean_text(clipboard, "all")
set_clipboard(text_result)
toast("Schránka vyčištěna ✨")
```

### Clean a link

Removes tracking parameters (utm_, fbclid…) from a shared link and copies it.

```
# @name "Clean a link"
# @icon link
# @triggers process_text, share
if starts(input, "http")
    edited_text = block("replace", input, "(?<=[?&])(utm_[a-z_]+|fbclid|gclid|si|igsh|ref|ref_src)=[^&#]*&?", "", true)
    edited_text2 = block("replace", edited_text, "[?&]+(?=#|$)", "", true)
    set_clipboard(edited_text2)
    toast("Odkaz bez sledování zkopírován")
else
    toast("Tohle není odkaz: " & input)
end
```

### Clean and share a link

Finds a link in a text, expands a shortened link, cleans it and offers Share again.

```
# @name "Clean and share a link"
# @icon link
# @triggers process_text, share
found = extract({source: input, what: "url", which: "first"})
if found == ""
    toast("V textu není žádný odkaz")
else
    web_result = web(found, "final_url")
    edited_text = block("replace", web_result, "(?<=[?&])(utm_[a-z_]+|fbclid|gclid|si|igsh|ref|ref_src)=[^&#]*&?", "", true)
    edited_text2 = block("replace", edited_text, "[?&]+(?=#|$)", "", true)
    share(edited_text2, "Sdílet vyčištěný odkaz")
end
```

### Translate to Czech

Opens the selected or shared text in Google Translate.

```
# @name "Translate to Czech"
# @icon translate
# @triggers process_text, share
converted_text = convert(input, "url_encode")
open_url("https://translate.google.com/?sl=auto&tl=cs&text=" & converted_text)
```

### Images from an API

API: downloads JSON with a list of images, shows them and copies the chosen one.

```
# @name "Images from an API"
# @icon code
api_response = http_request("GET", "https://dog.ceo/api/breeds/image/random/4")
value_from_json = json_get(api_response, "body.message", "value")
chosen_image = show_images("Vyber pejska", value_from_json, true)
set_clipboard(chosen_image)
toast("Adresa obrázku zkopírována")
```

### Titles from an API (loop)

API + loop: loads posts as JSON, goes through them and builds a list of titles.

```
# @name "Titles from an API (loop)"
# @icon code
api_response = http_request("GET", "https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts?_limit=5")
value_from_json = json_get(api_response, "body[*].title", "value")
nadpisy = ""
for item in value_from_json
    nadpisy = nadpisy & "• " & item & "\n"
end
show_text("Nadpisy příspěvků", nadpisy)
```

### Send data (POST JSON)

API: asks for a text, builds JSON from it, sends it with POST and shows the server's response.

```
# @name "Send data (POST JSON)"
# @icon code
entered_text = ask_text("Co poslat na server?", "Ahoj z Automation")
json = json_build("object", "zprava: " & entered_text & "\nodeslano: " & date() & "\nverze: 2")
api_response = http_request("POST", "https://httpbin.org/post", "", "json", json)
value_from_json = json_get(api_response, "status", "value")
value_from_json2 = json_get(api_response, "body.json", "pretty")
show_text("Server odpověděl " & value_from_json, value_from_json2)
```

### Watch an API for news

Try + Store value: gets the newest post from an API and reports it only when it differs from last time. A network error does not end it with an error. Goes well with the Time / interval event.

```
# @name "Watch an API for news"
# @icon code
# Try  (only as blocks, not in a script)
    api_response = http_request("GET", "https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts?_sort=id&_order=desc&_limit=1")
    value_from_json = json_get(api_response, "body[0].id", "value")
    value_from_json2 = json_get(api_response, "body[0].title", "value")
    stored_value = store_get("posledni_prispevek", "", "own")
    if value_from_json != stored_value
        toast("Nový příspěvek: " & value_from_json2)
        store_set("set", "posledni_prispevek", value_from_json, "own")
    else
        toast("Nic nového")
    end
# On failure  (only as blocks, not in a script)
    toast("API nedostupné: " & error)
# End of Try  (only as blocks, not in a script)
```

### Upload an image (multipart)

API: you pick an image, it is shrunk and sent with a caption as a form (multipart).

```
# @name "Upload an image (multipart)"
# @icon code
picked_file = pick_file("image/*")
edited_image = image_edit(picked_file, "resize", 1280)
entered_text = ask_text("Popisek obrázku", "Fotka z Automation")
api_response = http_request({method: "POST", url: "https://httpbin.org/post", headers: "", body_type: "multipart", fields: "popisek=" & entered_text & "\nobrazek=@" & edited_image, only_body: false, save_file: false, fail: false})
value_from_json = json_get(api_response, "status", "value")
value_from_json2 = json_get(api_response, "body.files", "keys")
value_from_json3 = json_get(api_response, "body.form.popisek", "value")
show_text("Server odpověděl " & value_from_json, "Server přijal soubory: " & value_from_json2 & "\nPopisek: " & value_from_json3)
```

### Script: cart total

Script: a list, a loop, a condition and a calculation in a few lines of code instead of ten blocks.

```
# @name "Script: cart total"
# @icon code
# The whole calculation is in one Script block. Open it and change the numbers.
# A list of objects, a loop, a calculation and building a text
items = [{name: "Bread", price: 42}, {name: "Cheese", price: 89.9}, {name: "Wine", price: 219}]
total = 0
for item in items
    total += item.price
end
if total > 300
    total = total * 0.9   # 10 % off
end
return "Items: " & len(items) & ", total " & round(total, 2)
show_text("Cart", script_result)
```

### Choose by: time of day

Choose by: asks for the time of day and runs one of the branches by the answer.

```
# @name "Choose by: time of day"
# @icon light
chosen_item = choose("What time of day is it?", "Morning\nNoon\nAfternoon\nEvening")
# Choose by chosen_item
if chosen_item == "Morning"
    toast("Good morning ☕")
else if chosen_item == "Noon" or chosen_item == "Afternoon"
    toast("Have a nice day ☀️")
else
    toast("Good evening 🌙")
end
```

### In parallel: two APIs at once

In parallel: sends two requests at once and joins them into one sentence with a script.

```
# @name "In parallel: two APIs at once"
# @icon sync
# In parallel  (only as blocks, not in a script)
    api_response = http_request({method: "GET", url: "https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1", headers: "", only_body: true})
# Meanwhile  (only as blocks, not in a script)
    api_response2 = http_request({method: "GET", url: "https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users/1", headers: "", only_body: true})
# End of parallel branches  (only as blocks, not in a script)
post = api_response
user = api_response2
return user.name & ": " & post.title
show_text("Both responses", script_result)
```

### Parallel loop: five APIs at once

For each item in parallel: downloads five posts at once and puts them into a list in the right order.

```
# @name "Parallel loop: five APIs at once"
# @icon repeat
for item in "1\n2\n3\n4\n5"  # in parallel
    api_response = http_request({method: "GET", url: "https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/" & item, headers: "", only_body: true})
    value_from_json = json_get(api_response, "title", "value")
    position = loop_index()
    text_result = position & ". " & value_from_json
end
return join(radky, "\n")
show_text("Post titles", script_result)
```

### Parallel sum from an API

Change variable: five requests at once and every round adds its number to a shared sum without the rounds overwriting it.

```
# @name "Parallel sum from an API"
# @icon repeat
for item in "1\n2\n3\n4\n5"  # in parallel
    api_response = http_request({method: "GET", url: "https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/" & item, headers: "", only_body: true})
    value_from_json = json_get(api_response, "id", "value")
    change_variable("soucet", "add", value_from_json)
end
show_text("Sum", soucet)
```

### Timer with pause

A notification with a countdown and the buttons Pause, Continue and Cancel. The buttons run this automation again and it tells from the Input what to do.

```
# @name "Timer with pause"
# @icon timer
if input == "pauza"
    seconds_left = notification_remaining("casovac")
    store_set("set", "casovac_zbyva", seconds_left, "own")
    notification({title: "Timer", text: "Paused, seconds left: " & seconds_left, quiet: true, name: "casovac", countdown: "", b1_action: "run", b1_label: "Continue", b1_automation: "", b1_input: "pokracovat", b2_action: "run", b2_label: "Cancel", b2_automation: "", b2_input: "zrusit", b3_action: "none"})
else if input == "pokracovat"
    stored_value = store_get("casovac_zbyva", 60, "own")
    notification({title: "Timer", text: "Running…", quiet: false, name: "casovac", countdown: stored_value, end_automation: "", end_input: "konec", b1_action: "run", b1_label: "Pause", b1_automation: "", b1_input: "pauza", b2_action: "run", b2_label: "Cancel", b2_automation: "", b2_input: "zrusit", b3_action: "none"})
else if input == "zrusit"
    notification_cancel("casovac")
    toast("Timer cancelled")
else if input == "konec"
    notification({title: "Time is up", text: "The timer has finished.", quiet: false, name: "", countdown: "", b1_action: "dismiss", b1_label: "OK", b2_action: "none"})
else
    notification({title: "Timer", text: "Running…", quiet: false, name: "casovac", countdown: "5:00", end_automation: "", end_input: "konec", b1_action: "run", b1_label: "Pause", b1_automation: "", b1_input: "pauza", b2_action: "run", b2_label: "Cancel", b2_automation: "", b2_input: "zrusit", b3_action: "none"})
end
```

### Notifications to a file

Writes every incoming notification as a row of a CSV or an item of a JSON. Run it by hand the first time: it asks for the file (new or existing) and keeps it with the Store value block.

```
# @name "Notifications to a file"
# @icon file
# @event notification
stored_value = store_get("soubor_oznameni", "", "own")
if stored_value == ""
    file_to_write_to = pick_save_file("", "oznameni")
    store_set("set", "soubor_oznameni", file_to_write_to, "own")
    toast("The file is chosen, notifications will be written into it")
else if event("notif_package") != ""
    add_record(stored_value, "cas=" & date() & "\n" & "aplikace=" & event("notif_app") & "\n" & "nadpis=" & event("notif_title") & "\n" & "text=" & event("notif_text") & "\n", "", ";")
end
```

### Condition as an expression: battery

If / Otherwise if written as an expression with “and / or” over the battery and the connection type.

```
# @name "Condition as an expression: battery"
# @icon battery
battery_result = battery("level")
network_result = network("type")
if battery_result < 30 and network_result != "wifi"
    toast("Low battery and on mobile data – save power.")
else if battery_result < 30 or battery_result > 95
    toast("The battery is at an edge: " & battery_result & " %")
else
    toast("The battery is fine: " & battery_result & " %")
end
```

### Find a place on the map (intent)

Send intent: asks for a place and opens it in maps (action VIEW, data geo:).

```
# @name "Find a place on the map (intent)"
# @icon map
entered_text = ask_text("Which place are you looking for?", "Praha")
send_intent("activity", "", "", "android.intent.action.VIEW", "geo:0,0?q=" & entered_text)
```

### Wait for Wi-Fi

Wait until + Try: waits up to 30 s for Wi-Fi, otherwise reports that it did not happen.

```
# @name "Wait for Wi-Fi"
# @icon wifi
# Try  (only as blocks, not in a script)
    wait_until(event("network"), "equals", "wifi", 30, 2, true)
    toast("Wi-Fi is connected ✔")
# On failure  (only as blocks, not in a script)
    toast("Wi-Fi did not connect within 30 s.")
# End of Try  (only as blocks, not in a script)
```
